lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-intensity circular pixel clusters extending longitudinally from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle, with the highest-luminance maxima concentrated in the mid-flank rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the longitudinal rows of spots, forming a grid-like topology where spots act as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges running parallel along the upper lateral flank, defined by a distinct linear luminance transition with highlights on the superior margin and cast shadows on the inferior margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs distributed within the first dorsal fin silhouette, with higher spatial frequency observed along the leading edge and proximal base relative to the distal trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp morphological gradient transition from large, low-frequency spots on the mid-lateral flank to a high-density distribution of micro-spots across the rostral and cranial surface.
